from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json
s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-sky-performance');a=s/'candidate-exclusive-v20e/tests';rows=[]
for mode in [0,3]:
 for folded in [0,1]:
  logs=[]
  for name,command in [('native',[str(a/'eka_cpu_fault_native')]),('wasm',['node',str(a/'eka_cpu_fault_wasm.js')])]:
   p=s/f'v20e-exclusive-{name}-m{mode}-h{folded}.log'
   with p.open('w') as f:subprocess.run(command+['--arm-exclusive',f'--tlb-hash={folded}',f'--unsafe-code={mode}'],stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
   data=[json.loads(x[6:])for x in p.read_text().splitlines()if x.startswith('FAULT ')]
   assert len(data)==4320,(p,len(data));logs.append(data)
  diffs=[dict(index=i,native=n,wasm=w)for i,(n,w)in enumerate(zip(*logs))if n!=w]
  result=dict(mode=mode,tlb_hash=folded,cases=len(logs[0]),differences=diffs)
  (s/f'v20e-exclusive-m{mode}-h{folded}.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2));rows.append(result)
  print(mode,folded,len(diffs),flush=True)
